# kopia_notification_profiles (Data Source)

Lists the notification profiles of the Kopia server: their names, methods and minimum severities. Settings are never listed, so no secret reaches the state through this data source; manage a profile with `kopia_notification_profile` to see them.

Useful to find the name of a profile set up in the Kopia UI or with the CLI, to import it as a `kopia_notification_profile`, or in a `check` block. Kopia keeps profiles in the repository, so the server needs one connected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kopia_notification_profiles" "all" {}

# Names, to import a profile set up in the Kopia UI or with the CLI.
output "notification_profiles" {
  value = { for profile in data.kopia_notification_profiles.all.profiles : profile.name => profile.method }
}

# Make sure failed snapshots do not go unnoticed.
check "kopia_notifies_errors" {
  assert {
    condition     = length(data.kopia_notification_profiles.all.profiles) > 0
    error_message = "The Kopia server has no notification profile, so nobody hears about failed snapshots."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `profiles` (Attributes List) Every profile, sorted by name. Kopia lists profiles by when they were last saved, and lists a name twice should two clients have saved it at the same moment; it is listed once here, as Kopia reads it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles`

Read-Only:

- `method` (String) How the profile sends: `email`, `pushover` or `webhook`, or a method Kopia knows but `kopia_notification_profile` does not manage, such as `testsender`.
- `min_severity` (String) Lowest severity of the notifications the profile receives. Kopia's severities, from the lowest, are `verbose`, `success`, `report`, `warning` and `error`. The server's scheduler sends a snapshot report as `report`, or as `warning` or `error` when the snapshot had problems; nothing Kopia sends today is below `report` except the test notification, which ignores this setting, so `verbose`, `success` and `report` currently behave the same. Kopia's API accepts any number here: one that has no name is shown as the number, such as `"3"`.
- `name` (String) Name of the profile, which is also the id to import it by as a `kopia_notification_profile`.
